name: Core Usage Report
intro_text: Please list each project that used your core this period. Please use one row per project. In the case where a lab has multiple projects that use your core, that lab can appear more than once. We’ll put your rows into NIH’s suggested Table 2 (Core Users) for the Center’s Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) to NIH, so you don’t need to fill in the table yourself.

about: Your list shows NIH who uses your core and what came of it.
Please use one row per project, and give the number of students in its own column.

sections.title: Projects that used the core this period
sections.instructions:
> How to count users: Please count everyone who worked on the project with the core as an individual user, students included. Then please give how many of those users were students.
> Your core’s RRID: Please ask every user lab to cite your core’s Research Resource Identifier (RRID) in the methods section of each paper, right after the core’s name. The RRID lets NIH and the Center find every paper your core made possible, even when the grant number isn’t cited. Your Center results page and the acknowledgment wording on the publications pages give users the exact text.
